#!/bin/ash
# Velocity Installation Script
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=velocity
USER_AGENT="Pterodactyl (https://pterodactyl.io)"

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
    echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{\$/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
    echo -e "Fetching latest version for ${PROJECT}..."
    VER_EXISTS=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT} | jq -r --arg VERSION "$VELOCITY_VERSION" '.versions[] | select(. == $VERSION)'`
    LATEST_VERSION=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT} | jq -r '.versions[-1]'`

    if [ -n "${VER_EXISTS}" ]; then
        echo -e "Using version ${VELOCITY_VERSION}"
    else
        echo -e "Version ${VELOCITY_VERSION} not found. Defaulting to latest version ${LATEST_VERSION}"
        VELOCITY_VERSION=${LATEST_VERSION}
    fi

    BUILD_EXISTS=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION} | jq -r --arg BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds[] | select(. == ($BUILD | tonumber))'`
    LATEST_BUILD=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION} | jq -r '.builds[-1]'`

    if [ -n "${BUILD_EXISTS}" ]; then
        echo -e "Using build ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    else
        echo -e "Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} not found. Defaulting to latest build ${LATEST_BUILD}"
        BUILD_NUMBER=${LATEST_BUILD}
    fi

    JAR_NAME=`curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER} | jq -r '.downloads.application.name'`
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"
fi

cd /mnt/server
echo -e "Downloading Velocity from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}
echo -e "Velocity downloaded successfully!"
